rules.statement: A party can establish a right to a servitude by showing that the water naturally flows from the upper tenement to the lower tenement, and the lower proprietor is only obliged to receive such water as flows in the ordinary course of nature.
rules.supporting_quote: Every owner of property is bound to receive the water which naturally drains onto his property from the land lying on a higher level than his own, nor may he raise any obstruction on his land whereby the water is dammed back on the property above him (Retief v. Louw, 4 Buch. p. 174; Ludolf v Wegner, 6 S.C. 193).
